title: failed early accusation
observed_actions: Tests a suspicion with an early bluff that does not expose Tenji.
observed_result: Initial attempt fails; more discriminating evidence is necessary.
epistemic_limits: Reassess after failure rather than retroactively making all failures deliberate.
counterfactual_test: A suspected insider ignores an accusation designed to provoke a reaction. Updates uncertainty; seeks an independent test. Reject: Declares the unresponsive suspect guilty or pretends the failure was guaranteed.
